Definition: from G4238; practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function:--deed, office, work.
BiblicalUsage: Praxis is a deed, a practice, a function. Jesus says the Son of man shall reward every man according to his works, and Luke says many believers came and showed their deeds, confessing them openly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe deeds tell the truth about faith, and the day of reward will weigh what I did, not what I said.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
